name: The Sales Loadout
tagline: Close more deals, write fewer emails, never drop a follow-up again.
heroHeadline: Stop losing deals to follow-up failures.
heroSubhead: The complete Claude AI setup for sales reps and small dealerships — built for beginners, live in under 30 minutes.
problem: You sent the quote. They said "let me think about it." And then nothing. You meant to follow up — you just ran out of hours.
You're rewriting the same email fifteen times a day, just swapping names and deal numbers while leads age in your inbox.
Your competitors have full BDC teams and AI tools their OEM pays for. You have yourself and a CRM you barely open.
There's a deal in your pipeline right now that could close — if someone just sent the right message at the right time.
shift: What if the follow-up sent itself? What if every email took 30 seconds instead of 15 minutes? What if you walked into every customer conversation already knowing exactly what to say — and how to handle whatever they throw at you?

faqs.q: Do I need to know anything about AI or coding?
faqs.a: No. The setup guide walks you through every step with screenshots. If you can copy and paste, you can do this. Most people are up and running in under 30 minutes.

faqs.q: What is Claude AI? Do I need a subscription?
faqs.a: Claude is an AI assistant made by Anthropic — similar to ChatGPT but sharper for writing and sales tasks. You'll need a Claude Pro subscription ($20/month) to use skills and plugins. The Sales Loadout is the curated setup that makes Claude actually useful for your day-to-day work.

faqs.q: How is this different from just prompting ChatGPT?
faqs.a: Generic AI gives generic results. The Sales Loadout is pre-configured for sales reps and dealerships — the skills understand your deal stages, your objections, your follow-up timing. You get far better output without starting from scratch every single time.

faqs.q: What if it doesn't work for me?
faqs.a: 14-day no-questions-asked refund. Email us, we'll sort it out. No hoops.

faqs.q: Can I use this for my whole sales team?
faqs.a: The standard licence covers one rep. If you want to set up 3 or more people, reach out before buying — team pricing is available.

faqs.q: Does this work for any type of sales, or just dealerships?
faqs.a: Built with dealerships as the flagship example, but the skills work for any B2C or high-ticket B2B sales role. If your work involves follow-up sequences, written outreach, and objection handling — this fits.
